blocks.text: Insani zaraye ya to mutaharrik (mobile: cars, trucks, hawai jahaz, bahri engines) hain ya point zaraye (factories, bijli ghar waghaira). Gariyon ke engines, factories aur bijli gharon mein fossil fuels (coal, fuel oils aur natural gas) ka jalna carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide aur methane jaise hydrocarbons paida karta hai. Gharelu fuel ke taur par lakri ka jalna aur bhattiyon (brick kilns) mein coal ka jalna bhi air pollutants ke zaraye hain.

blocks.prompt: Hawa ki aaloodgi ke insani zaraye batayein (Quick Check 14.2a).
blocks.explanation: Mutaharrik zaraye, cars, trucks, hawai jahazon aur jahazon ke engines, aur point zaraye, factories aur bijli ghar, sab fossil fuels jala kar CO2, CO aur hydrocarbons chhorte hain; nez gharelu fuel ke taur par jalai gai lakri aur bhattiyon mein jala coal.

items: Insani: fossil fuels jalane wale mutaharrik (gariyan, hawai jahaz, jahaz) aur point (factories, bijli ghar) zaraye, CO2, CO, hydrocarbons dete hue; lakri ka fuel; bhattiyon mein coal.
